frame.origin: centre of the reproduced area, ground plane
frame.wind_direction_rotation: Meteorological: the compass name is the direction the wind comes FROM (N = 0 deg blows toward -y, E = 90 deg toward -x), clockwise from north. This case keeps its geographic frame instead of '+x along the wind' because the district is real and its coordinates are the data's.

column_meaning.point_id: the tunnel's own measurement point number
column_meaning.config: configuration key: 'default', Case C centre building '0D'/'1D'/'2D', Case E state 'bc' (before) / 'ac' (after construction)
column_meaning.wind_direction: compass name of the direction the wind comes FROM (Case E)
column_meaning.wind_direction_deg: AIJ wind direction in degrees; 0 is the case's reference direction (see frame)
column_meaning.velocity_ratio: dimensionless, Vs / U(15.9 m) with U(15.9 m) = 3.935 m/s (Case E)
